screen.subject: 学習アプリ 利用分析
screen.line: 前半のレッスンで離脱が多い

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 9: 25 words — analysis & learning.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to two colleagues talking in a café.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Kimura, have you finished analysing that learning app yet?
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Yes. Looking at the overall results, it's clear that many people quit during the first half of the lessons.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Is it simply that the questions are hard?
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: I don't think that's all. When we asked users why, some said the settings were hard to understand.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: I see. Which part are they pointing to when they say that?
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: The first screen, where you choose your reason for learning and your level.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: If you get lost there, problems tend to come up even after you move to another screen.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Yes. And the results also differed by region.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: It's hard to apply the usual approach to every region.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Right. I think the suitable approach is different for each group.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: How did you measure study time?
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: We used the app's records. But a lot of them come from particular users, so we need to keep that in mind.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Is there anything else to watch out for?
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: The numbers alone may not show the real reason. Next, I'll talk to people directly.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: learning.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Studying to gain knowledge or skills.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I keep up thirty minutes of study a day.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Coming to know something by being taught or copying.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I learned how to do the job from a senior colleague.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: What something is aimed at.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This seminar is for new employees.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: A set way or format.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please choose a payment method.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Well suited to the occasion or person.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please come to the meeting appropriately dressed.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Each one, individually.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's hear what each person thinks.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Widespread and ordinary.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The general public can use this service too.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Applying one thing to fit another.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll try applying this method to other shops too.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next: analysing.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Breaking something down to study it closely.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I analysed the sales data.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Measuring amount or size, for example with a machine.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll measure the room temperature.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: All of something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll explain the overall flow first.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: The first of two halves.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The first half of the meeting is reports.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Clear and plain to see.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The investigation made the cause clear.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Pinning down one particular thing.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll email only certain customers.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The chance that something may happen.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: There is a chance of rain tomorrow.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: A matter, and what it involves.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Make a note of important matters.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: bearing in mind, paying attention to

lines.en: Keeping something in mind and taking care.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please bear the following points in mind.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Last: places & movement.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A defined area of land.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: It snows a lot in this area.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A particular spot within the whole.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Underline the places that are wrong.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Setting up how a device works.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I changed my phone's language setting.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Changing places.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's move to the meeting room.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Showing something clearly, for example with a finger.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Point to this place on the map.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Asking someone about something you don't know.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I asked the way to the station.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Coming about; arising.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A new problem has arisen.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Merely; only that.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This is merely my opinion.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 分析, analysed.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 対象, is aimed at.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which means asking someone about something?

lines.en: Question 3. Which means asking someone about something?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 尋ねる.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Please come to the meeting in ___ clothes.

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: ふさわしい, appropriate.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 明らか, clear.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words: analysis & learning.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
